_about: Hand-kept. The model's lows (lows.json) have no names, so a name is attached by position: add one entry per storm when the Met Office, Met Eireann or KNMI names it, with the centre's position at a stated time taken from their announcement or warning. The map gives the name to the track that passes closest to that point (within 110 km/h of travel since that time, plus 300 km). Add the entry as soon as the storm is named; no rebuild is needed. Names are facts from the services' public announcements, copied by hand, never scraped.
